# Battery Drain

## Overview
Field units from batch 4 reported significantly faster battery drain than specified when operating under specific firmware conditions. This issue, tracked under ticket MESH-118, specifically impacts devices utilizing MeshSync relay mode.

## Key Details
- **Issue Description:** Batch 4 field units experienced battery drain approximately 30% faster than specification once MeshSync relay mode was enabled.
- **Configuration Check:** The read interval was set to the current firmware default (version 0.3.8) of 15 minutes, ruling out an interval misconfiguration.
- **Root Cause:** Bench testing by Jonah Park confirmed that the relay radio's sleep timer resets on every received packet. In a busy mesh network, this prevents the radio from ever entering sleep mode.
- **Proposed Fix:** A draft fix under MESH-118 aims to reduce the radio wake time from 400ms to 80ms per hop. A candidate build (version 0.3.9) was scheduled for release to allow for retesting.

## Related Entities
- **Aurora Labs:** The organization developing the firmware and hardware.
- **Mira Chen:** Author of the initial field report detailing the battery drain.
- **Jonah Park:** Engineer who confirmed the bench test results and drafted the fix.

## Related Concepts
- **MeshSync Relay Mode:** Operating mode that enables devices to relay network traffic, which inadvertently triggered the excessive power consumption.
- **Firmware Versions:** 
  - Version 0.3.8 (current default with the bug)
  - Version 0.3.9 (candidate build containing the fix)
